'''Narralla''' was a [[Devlikk/Legends|Devlikk]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who led a resistance movement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Narralla's hatred toward the Empire began when it killed her parents.<ref name="OaA1" />
